document_title: The fee, the network, and who was reading it

S1.dek: The council voted unanimously to end its agreement with Flock. Its cameras read license plates.
labels: CAMERAS IN THE CITY CONTRACT c20 THE VOTE WAS UNANIMOUS c19

S2.dek: All 28 automated license plate reader cameras in the contract will be turned off and covered.
labels: 28 CAMERAS IN THE CITY CONTRACT, AND THE RECORD SAYS THEY WILL BE COVERED RATHER THAN TAKEN DOWN c20

S3.dek: 459 outside organizations ran nearly 1.6 million searches that included this network.
labels: OUTSIDE ORGANIZATIONS THAT RAN SEARCHES INCLUDING PFLUGERVILLE'S CAMERA NETWORK, LAST SIX MONTHS c21
